nota: Refeito (F108–F112): tudo bate. Sugiro inteiros na tela (59 → 32 %, 8 → 26 %), que valem pelos dois métodos; com uma casa, a 2.ª casa muda conforme o método (0.1 a 0.2 ponto). F113: BC Hydro 2026, p. 25. Protagonista: a curva de depois (--destaque); a de antes, --contraparte.
conversoes: as partes do dossiê (58.8, 31.6, 7.8, 25.8 %) saem das 12 médias mensais com peso igual; pesando cada mês pelos seus dias: 58.9, 31.8, 7.7 e 25.6 %

texto_aprovado: Before the big storage dams went in upstream, on both sides of the border, June dwarfed February there. With all of them in place, the river's busiest month carries only about twice its quietest, and the total for the year has barely changed. The water wasn't taken away. It was moved: into winter, to make power, and out of spring, to leave room for the flood.
